verdict.rationale: Fellow is a SaaS AI meeting-notes product, and self-hosting is a fair openness question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The evidence documents only cloud capabilities: a REST API, webhooks, a hosted MCP server, retention policies and Super Admin export. None of it mentions a self-hosted, on-premises or open-source deployment of the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
